title: Doesnt work properly
body: Im getting month goal every time and it doesnt count it. The same with other goals. Half of the app doesnt work in europe and i cant reach nobody with support
author: saskoko

title: Unable to edit workouts
body: When you forget to stop a workout at the correct time, you can’t edit the workout to be able to get correct results
author: Schaltza

title: Fitness app should record top speed during running
body: Most of us are using this app for sport purposes. If the app track the average pace, it could also track highest and the lowest speed while running, especially if we are running sprints in practice. It would help a lot of us. Just a thought. Overall great app.
author: Akousulting

title: Route tracking stopped working
body: App is OK… simple to use. Some things could be more detailed. But most frustrating thing is that it stopped tracking workout routes. Tried every “solution” on google, but still doesnt work. Must be an iOS related problem i guess. Hope they fix it with update!
author: TheRealDeal91

title: Stats are not up to date
body:
It’s now the 2nd of May, and I didn’t receive the perfect month badge for April.
When I check my ‘longest move streak’ it says my longest streak ended on April 28th, and my current streak - 4 days later - is 101 days already. 

Please fix the these statistics, it seems like they are only being updated once a week.
Shutting down the app and restarting it doesn’t help.
author: Tiborkjell

title: Minimum effort app
body: Poor, unreadable HR graphs. With a little more attention the app could be much better.
author: zosjx

title: Wrong calorie counter
body: the app accompanied with the watch work well so far but today it started to count calories wrong. with 90 minutes of workout i usually burned around 900 cal., today I'm at 4000. please fix this.
